title: Sordland/Turn01/Shooting
description: The shooting at the palace creates chaos.

entries.speaker: START
entries.title: START

entries.speaker: INPUT
entries.title: input

entries.speaker: OUTPUT
entries.title: output

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl Greiser, head of the Sordish P..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl Greiser, head of the Sordish Police Force, was running towards us with three more police officers in decorated uniforms. They all had their guns drawn.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: "<shout>"NO! GUNSHOTS!!!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>"NO! GUNSHOTS!!!"</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as he made it to us and saw..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as he made it to us and saw that we were unharmed, he let out a big sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica was still trying to tend to..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica was still trying to tend to Deana as Franc paced the room, mumbling that he should have stayed home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as Monica heard the word, s..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as Monica heard the word, she lunged from her seat.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“I am sorry, sir. I will personally..."
entries.dialogueText: “I am sorry, sir. I will personally conduct the investigation into our palace security force once we figure out what is going on. I can assure you I will be relentless in dealing with incompetence.”

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“He fired three shots at an MP -- o..."
entries.dialogueText: “He fired three shots at an MP -- one to the head, two to the body -- instantly killing him.”

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What a fucking night.""
entries.dialogueText: "What a fucking night."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Presidential guards at the palace..."
entries.dialogueText: “Presidential guards at the palace immediately shot and killed the attacker. He has not been identified yet and will require an investigation.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“GET DOWN!"</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“GET DOWN!"</shout>
entries.menuText: “GET DOWN!"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“The MP that was killed was identif..."
entries.dialogueText: “The MP that was killed was identified as Bernard Circas.“

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room went quiet. Petr seemed li..."
entries.dialogueText: The room went quiet. Petr seemed like he was about to say something, but with one look from me, he stopped.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This is huge, Anton. This will cau..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is huge, Anton. This will cause a lot of problems."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I threw myself on Monica, Deana and..."
entries.dialogueText: I threw myself on Monica, Deana and Franc to shield them.
entries.menuText: Shield Monica and kids.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""A lot of problems...""
entries.dialogueText: "A lot of problems..."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "<shout>“ANTON, THE KIDS!”</shout>"
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“ANTON, THE KIDS!”</shout>

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr pulled out two cigarettes and..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr pulled out two cigarettes and handed me one. He then turned to Evelyn. I could hear him trying to reassure her that everything was going to be all right.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We promptly followed Karl through t..."
entries.dialogueText: We promptly followed Karl through the winding halls and corridors of the palace. His men still had their guns drawn, which did nothing to ease the tension. On the way, Petr made an attempt to break the silence.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“This is what we know so far. We ha..."
entries.dialogueText: “This is what we know so far. We have confirmed that two people were gunned down in front of the palace. The attacker is one of them and we have reasons to believe he was working alone.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica, Deana and Franc all looked..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica, Deana and Franc all looked at me beseechingly. I rushed to shield them.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“As you command, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “As you command, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured towards a more private..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured towards a more private corner of the room and starting speaking more quietly.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Do not worry. The situation is now..."
entries.dialogueText: “Do not worry. The situation is now under control. Please follow me.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deana started crying again because..."
entries.dialogueText: Deana started crying again because of my yelling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl flipped a switch on the wall a..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl flipped a switch on the wall and a panel opened, revealing a hidden staircase leading to a large reinforced door. Inside, a set of emergency lights flickered on. The safe room was comfortable and spacious, with expensive-looking leather sofas.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“If I may, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “If I may, sir.”

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa! What's happening!?""
entries.dialogueText: “Papa! What's happening!?"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Paul, Jansen, follow my lead. We w..."
entries.dialogueText: “Paul, Jansen, follow my lead. We will bring them to the safe room.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I knew it! We never should've come!""
entries.dialogueText: "I knew it! We never should've come!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“YOU'D BETTER FOR YOUR SAKE...."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“YOU'D BETTER FOR YOUR SAKE. STATUS UPDATE!"</shout>
entries.menuText: “YOU BETTER FOR YOUR SAKE. STATUS UPDATE!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good. So what is going on?""
entries.dialogueText: “Good. So what is going on?"
entries.menuText: “Good. So what is going on?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced towards Monica, Evelyn a..."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced towards Monica, Evelyn and the kids.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He now turned to Monica, Evelyn and..."
entries.dialogueText: He now turned to Monica, Evelyn and the children and spoke in a softer voice.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Chaos broke out as some guests flun..."
entries.dialogueText: Chaos broke out as some guests flung themselves under their tables and others ran towards the doors, screaming. Deana burst into tears while Franc tried to comfort her, hiding the fear in his own eyes.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“No, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, sir.”

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Good news. We are not in any dange..."
entries.dialogueText: “Good news. We are not in any danger at the moment. The situation has been dealt with and the perimeter has been secured by the guards and the police.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Three more gunshots rang out loudly..."
entries.dialogueText: Three more gunshots rang out loudly.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Certainly not, sir.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Certainly not, sir.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl turned to us with a serious fa..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl turned to us with a serious face as we were about to round a corner.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Mr. President! Are you all right?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President! Are you all right?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You can say that again.""
entries.dialogueText: “You can say that again."
entries.menuText: “You can say that again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“THEN TELL ME HOW THIS CIRCU..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“THEN TELL ME HOW THIS CIRCUS SHOW HAPPENED AT MY BALL."</shout>
entries.menuText: “THEN TELL ME HOW THIS CIRCUS SHOW HAPPENED IN MY BALL."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“One second, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “One second, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sorry for yelling, Karl. I'm just..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry for yelling, Karl. I'm just a bit nervous right now."
entries.menuText: “Sorry for yelling, Karl. I'm just a bit nervous right now."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "I completely understand, sir. I wil..."
entries.dialogueText: I completely understand, sir. I will personally conduct the investigation into our palace security force and I can assure you I will be relentless in dealing with incompetence.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl's radio suddenly crackled to l..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl's radio suddenly crackled to life. Every second felt like an eternity as he pressed his ear to the receiver. When it fell silent, he turned to us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't you shut your mouth for a bi..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't you shut your mouth for a bit?"
entries.menuText: “Can't you shut your mouth for a bit?"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“I should receive confirmation soon..."
entries.dialogueText: “I should receive confirmation soon, Mr. President. Everything is under control.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sssshh. Not now, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: “Sssshh. Not now, Petr."
entries.menuText: “Sssshh. Not now Petr."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's not over yet.""
entries.dialogueText: “It's not over yet."
entries.menuText: “It's not over yet."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr let out a nervous laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Petr let out a nervous laugh.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“So, what's the status?""
entries.dialogueText: “So, what's the status?"
entries.menuText: “So, what's the status?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Small security monitors on the wall..."
entries.dialogueText: Small security monitors on the wall displayed grainy footage of each room in the palace. There was a boardroom and a pantry containing enough provisions to last us months. Monica and Evelyn sat the children down and started wiping their tears.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“I should receive confirmation soon..."
entries.dialogueText: “I should receive confirmation soon, Mr. President. Everything is under control.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Check the perimeter.""
entries.dialogueText: “Check the perimeter."
entries.menuText: “Check the perimeter."

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Thank God.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank God.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around quickly to his men..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around quickly to his men.

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“Quiet, please.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Quiet, please.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are we under attack? Who is attack..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are we under attack? Who is attacking us? What is going on?!"
entries.menuText: “Are we under attack? Who is attacking us? What is going on?!"

entries.speaker: Karl Greiser
entries.title: Karl Greiser: "“CHECK THE PERIMETER! NOW!”"
entries.dialogueText: “CHECK THE PERIMETER! NOW!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Karl stepped away from us and made..."
entries.dialogueText: Karl stepped away from us and made a few radio calls. When he was done, he returned to me and Petr.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“STATUS REPORT!""
entries.dialogueText: “STATUS REPORT!"
entries.menuText: “STATUS REPORT!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not the best inauguration ball I'v..."
entries.dialogueText: “Not the best inauguration ball I've been to."
entries.menuText: “Not the best inauguration ball I've been to."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What the hell is going on?!""
entries.dialogueText: “What the hell is going on?!"
entries.menuText: “What the hell is going on?!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Are we under attack? Who is attack..."
entries.dialogueText: “Are we under attack? Who is attacking us? What is going on?!"
entries.menuText: “Are we under attack? Who is attacking us? What is going on?!"

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Petr, shut up.""
entries.dialogueText: “Petr, shut up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“So tell me Karl. DO I HAVE..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“So tell me Karl. DO I HAVE CLOWNS FOR A SECURITY FORCE?"</shout>
entries.menuText: “So tell me Karl. DO I HAVE CLOWNS FOR A SECURITY FORCE?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I raised my voice, he lowered hi..."
entries.dialogueText: As I raised my voice, he lowered his head in respect.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sorry, I talk when I get nervous.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, I talk when I get nervous."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat down beside my wife and child..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat down beside my wife and children.
entries.menuText: Comfort Monica and the kids.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I lit the cigarette and took a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: I lit the cigarette and took a deep drag.
entries.menuText: Smoke alone.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Petr, old friend, what the hell ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Petr, old friend, what the hell have we gotten ourselves into?"
entries.menuText: "Petr, old friend, what the hell have we gotten ourselves into?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nothing like this will ever happen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing like this will ever happen again. I'll make sure of it."
entries.menuText: "Nothing like this will ever happen again. I'll make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I continued smoking, a peculiar..."
entries.dialogueText: As I continued smoking, a peculiar calm washed over me.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""We can't be sure of anything anymo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't be sure of anything anymore, Anton."
entries.menuText: "We can't be sure of anything anymore, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I lit my cigarette and took a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: I lit my cigarette and took a deep drag. I was going to see this through and keep my family safe.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was going to see this through."
entries.dialogueText: I was going to see this through.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nothing you and I can't handle, An..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing you and I can't handle, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I lit my cigarette and took a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: I lit my cigarette and took a deep drag. We were going to see this through.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We are safe. I'll make sure everyt..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are safe. I'll make sure everything's going to be fine."
entries.menuText: "We are safe. I'll make sure everything's going to be fine."
